model.name: gate.recordVerdict
model.description: Record a gate verdict as a scenario unit. Types: deploy-gate (version+tag), det-3x (3 identical runs), parity (old⊆new), tron-qa (Tron approval). Links to gated entity (Test/Task/Sprint IOR). Status pass/fail + evidence IOR (screenshot/log). Created by tester/planner/PO at gate time.
